findings.title: Upgrade help is the most searched topic without a page
findings.evidence: “v8” (44) and “upgrade” (31) are the top two site searches. None of the 10 most visited pages cover upgrading.
findings.recommendation: Add an upgrade page, or a clearly labeled section on the installation page.

findings.title: Installation guidance is working
findings.evidence: The installation page has 74% engagement, the highest on the site, and is the 2nd most visited page.
findings.recommendation: No change needed. Linking to it from the FAQ would help visitors who start there.
